description: Assign a coupon / promotion code to an affiliate so sales using it are credited to them. The code must match one defined in Stripe, and the affiliate's campaign must have a campaign coupon set in the dashboard. Rewardful: POST /v1/affiliate_coupons.

token.description: The exact coupon / promotion code as defined in Stripe, e.g. MYCODE.

name: rewardful_create_affiliate_coupon
title: Create an affiliate coupon
